capture.zh: 螺旋星系巨石星，点击地图中的石像挑战；打败获得兰斯特的精元和成就「击败兰斯特」，精元经分子转化器孵化得到卡斯。

strategy_notes.zh: 丽莎布布+布鲁克克/布林克克+消强精灵：盖亚消强，海洋之心磨到半血以下，丽莎布布强化后大招带过；用飞行、草、超能系克制。

engine_notes: reflect_damage: any single hit dealing more than 1200 damage reflects 1/4 of that damage to the attacker.
Once, when at low HP (残血), it heals a flat 500 HP; the exact threshold is not stated (20% assumed).
海洋之心 works; 寄生种子 does not. Frequently uses 大地崩裂 to weaken the player.
skills: all four are named by a period guide (4399 2012-02-08) and equal species 1085's last four at or below Lv80.
reward: original reward was the species' 精元 (essence), hatched in the 分子转化器 into the base form (e.g. 兰斯特 精元 → 卡斯, 伊索里 → 伊索的精元); encoded as the base-form species at Lv1.

Immune to stat drops: Default per user 2026-10-21 (哈莫雷特及以后多数boss都免疫弱化和自带攻击+2); no period source mentions drops on it. Its documented innate boost is atk+1 (4399 2012-02-08 and 2012-08-13: 天生攻击强化+1), which replaces the default atk+2; undated Baidu Baike's +2 is later. The modern client's list has no idx 1.
